text.card: A star about 60 parsecs away, 1.5 times the Sun's width, measured by Gaia.
text.introduction: Gaia's parallax, brightness and spectrum give it 1.5 solar radii and 1.05 solar masses (FLAME) and 5,783 K at its surface (GSP-Phot).

quotes.title: HD 181720
quotes.card: HD 181720 is star with an orbiting substellar companion in the southern constellation of Sagittarius.
quotes.introduction: It is located at a distance of 196 light-years from the Sun based on parallax measurements, but is drifting closer with a radial velocity of −45.4 km/s.
